calls.reason: This is a broad, opinion-like generalization. The packet has the DHS board membership and studies of how industry influences policy, but nothing showing how often AI regulation was actually captured.

The Senate transcript shows Altman saying only that he had no equity. TIME reported his indirect YC stake, and in 2026 court testimony he admitted not mentioning it. Reuters confirms he owned the Startup Fund until March 2024.

The Form 990 confirms the mission wording, but it was an annual return, not an application for exempt status. The 49% figure comes from earlier Fortune reporting on staged terms, and the safety point is hedged and rests on Leike's view.

Fortune's own sources said the team never got anything close to 20% and its extra compute requests were routinely rejected. The team was disbanded within a year, and Leike said it struggled for compute, so the promise was effectively not kept.
This is a sweeping summary with no count or clear standard. The packet only shows the four-year superalignment pledge and does not establish several promises that were already broken.
